locations.name: Fountain
locations.description: Central campus landmark and key navigation anchor point.
facts: Navigation anchor landmark
Right turn from entrance leads towards campus spine
First left leads to Udaya Upahara
Second left leads to Engineering and Admission blocks

locations.name: Udaya Upahara
locations.description: Popular campus dining outlet and food stall serving traditional South Indian snacks and meals.
facts: Located at the first left turn when walking from the fountain

locations.name: Engineering Block
locations.description: Major academic block housing engineering departments. Connects internally to H, J, and K blocks, and leads toward N, P, Q, R, S, and U blocks.
facts: Reached via second left turn from the fountain path
Located beside Admission Block
Internal pathway leads to H, J, K blocks and continues towards N, P, Q, R, S, U

locations.name: Admission Block
locations.description: Administrative facility handling admissions, registrar queries, and visitor services. Located adjacent to the Engineering Block.
facts: Located beside Engineering Block
First floor houses the Office of the Registrar
Opposite to food stalls including Subway, Hatti Kaapi, Aromas of Malenadu, Taj Delight

locations.name: Office of the Registrar
locations.description: Official office of the University Registrar handling university governance, student records, and registrations.
facts: Located on the first floor of the Admission Block building (beside Engineering Block)

locations.name: Office of Controller of Examination
locations.description: Administrative unit managing semester examinations, grade cards, and evaluations.
facts: Located in Admin Block complex with service counters for students

locations.name: Dean Office of MBA Department
locations.description: Office of the Dean for the School of Management / MBA Department.
facts: Executive academic office overseeing MBA programs

locations.name: Nexus Core
locations.description: High-traffic student connective walkway, atrium, and multipurpose central concourse.
facts: Major connecting corridor and atrium for multiple academic wings

locations.name: Food Stalls opposite Admission Block
locations.description: Cluster of branded food outlets opposite Admission Block, including Subway, Hatti Kaapi, Aromas of Malenadu, and Taj Delight. Path beside them leads to sports area.
facts: Located opposite Admission Block on the right side of the straight path from fountain
Includes Subway, Hatti Kaapi, Aromas of Malenadu, and Taj Delight
Walking into food stalls opens access to the sports courts on the right

locations.name: Stationery Shop
locations.description: Campus stationery, supplies, and photocopying store situated near the entrance to D Block.
facts: Key visual landmark right before reaching D Block

locations.name: D Block
locations.description: Prominent academic building located straight ahead from Admission Block past the stationery shop. Houses the School of Design on the 5th floor.
facts: Located straight ahead from Admission Block near the stationery shop
5th floor houses the School of Design
Taking a left from D Block leads to E, F, and L blocks
Connects to E and F seminar halls on the left

locations.name: School of Design
locations.description: Specialized academic school for design, architecture, and creative media, located on the fifth floor of D Block.
facts: Located on the fifth floor of D Block

locations.name: E Block
locations.description: Academic and research building reached by turning left from D Block. Contains E block seminar hall and the Research & Development Centre.
facts: Reached by taking a left from D Block
Houses E Block Seminar Hall on the left
Houses the Research and Development Centre (R&D Centre) on ground and 1st floor

locations.name: Research and Development Centre (R&D Centre)
locations.description: Advanced innovation and research hub situated on the ground and first floors of E Block.
facts: Located on the ground and first floor of E Block

locations.name: F Block
locations.description: Academic building adjacent to E Block, featuring F Block Seminar Hall and serving as the direct pedestrian thoroughfare leading to L Block.
facts: Located after E Block on the left wing path
Contains F block seminar hall
Directly connects toward L Block

locations.name: L Block
locations.description: Major department building reached from F Block. Houses School of Media Studies on ground floor, Dean's Office on 1st floor, and has food stalls nearby.
facts: Reached directly from F Block
Ground floor houses School of Media Studies
First floor houses Dean's Office
Left side features food stalls: Hatti Kaapi, V Mart, Crazy Cups, Lassi Area

locations.name: School of Media Studies
locations.description: Creative school equipped with soundstages and TV Studio on the ground floor of L Block.
facts: Located on the ground floor of L Block
Features dedicated TV Studio facilities

locations.name: Dean's Office (L Block)
locations.description: Dean's executive office on the first floor of L Block overseeing humanities and media programs.
facts: Located on the first floor of L Block

locations.name: Food Stalls near L Block / P Block
locations.description: Food stall arcade situated to the left of L Block and also accessible from the N-to-P corridor. Includes Hatti Kaapi, V Mart / VJ Mart, Crazy Cups, and Lassi Area.
facts: Located to the left in L Block
Also found when traveling from N Block to P Block on the right side
Includes Hatti Kaapi, V Mart / VJ Mart, Crazy Cups, and Lassi Area / Lassi House

locations.name: Sports Area & Courts
locations.description: Comprehensive outdoor athletic complex with basketball, throwball, volleyball, and football courts, along with an indoor gym, sports equipment room, and table tennis area.
facts: Accessed by walking into the food stalls opposite Admission Block and turning right
Contains basketball court, throwball court, volleyball court, football court, and sports room
Includes indoor games hall with table tennis and student gym

locations.name: N Block
locations.description: Academic building connected from the Engineering Block interior complex, leading toward P Block.
facts: Accessible from inside Engineering Block
Leads directly towards P Block and food arcade

locations.name: P Block
locations.description: Academic building on the southern pedestrian spine. Food stalls are located on its right side.
facts: Located along the path from N block
Has food stalls on its right side
Leads forward to Q, R, S, and U blocks

locations.name: Q Block
locations.description: Connecting academic wing between P Block and R Block.
facts: Follows P Block in the spine connection

locations.name: R Block
locations.description: Academic block located between Q Block and S Block.
facts: Located along path from Q Block to S and U blocks

locations.name: S Block
locations.description: Substantial academic building housing the School of Law on the 5th floor.
facts: Reached through the P-Q-R corridor
5th floor houses the School of Law

locations.name: School of Law
locations.description: Academic legal faculty located on the fifth floor of S Block. Features moot court rooms and dedicated Law Library.
facts: Located on the fifth floor of S Block
Near dedicated Law Library on campus

locations.name: U Block
locations.description: Terminal academic block in the southern building sequence alongside S Block.
facts: Located at the end of the P-Q-R-S spine

locations.name: Domino's Pizza
locations.description: Campus Domino's quick-service pizza kiosk located outdoors.
facts: Outdoor branded pizzeria kiosk opposite M Block / Cafeteria zone

locations.name: Central Library
locations.description: Multi-level campus library housing extensive book stacks, digital catalog, study pods, and computer reference terminals.
facts: Main knowledge resource center with turnstile security entrance

locations.name: AI Centre of Excellence
locations.description: Advanced artificial intelligence research lab partnered with NVIDIA, equipped with high-performance computing clusters.
facts: Equipped with GPU computing workstations and AI research labs

locations.name: VR Studio
locations.description: Immersive Virtual Reality and Augmented Reality lab equipped with VR headsets and motion tracking.
facts: Dedicated immersive simulation facility

locations.name: Department of Civil Engineering
locations.description: Civil engineering labs, structural testing centers, and departmental faculty cabins.
facts: Located inside Engineering Block wing

locations.name: Campus Auditorium
locations.description: State-of-the-art auditorium for convocations, symposiums, and cultural festivals.
facts: Adjacent to Amphitheater and cafeteria terrace

locations.name: Amphitheater
locations.description: Open-air landscaped amphitheater with tiered seating steps, popular for student gatherings.
facts: Scenic green amphitheater overlooking garden lawns
